title: Rav Geviha of Argiza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Gittin 7a Rav Huna bar Natan said to Rav Ashi, “What is the meaning of what is written?” — [Rav Huna bar Natan] said to him: “Rav Geviha of Argiza gave a reason for this: whoever has a grievance against his fellow and keeps silent, He who dwells forever executes judgment for him.” Rav Ashi said to him: “If so, Tziklag?” He [Rav Huna bar Natan] said to him: “If Rav Geviha of Bei Argiza were here, he would give a reason for it.” Hyman infers from this that he was a renowned preacher in Rav Ashi’s time.

notes.text: The supplied dashes omit Rav Ashi’s first answer that the verse lists towns. Saved Davidson Gittin 7a shows Rav Huna bar Natan citing Rav Geviha, Rav Ashi objecting, and Rav Huna answering again. Bracketed identifications clarify those speakers; the biblical verses remain omitted as in the supplied notice.
